description: "The Cooking Manual of Practical Directions for Economical Every-Day Cookery" by Juliet Corson is a culinary guide written in the late 19th century. This book serves as a practical resource for housekeepers and cooks aiming to create delicious and nutritious meals while minimizing wastage and expense.
